channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Cillian Murphy's Jim plays a big part in the '28 Years Later: The Bone Temple' ending
item.description: "28 Years Later" director Danny Boyle plans to have Cillian Murphy's Jim character be the main focus of a third movie.

item.title: Netflix CEO Ted Sarandos tries to solve his movie problem
item.description: Netflix made streaming movies at home a big part of its pitch. Now, as it tries to buy Warner Bros. and its giant movie business, things are changing.

item.title: ChatGPT ads might not be a totally bad thing. Hear me out on this.
item.description: ChatGPT says it's bringing ads to some US users. It might be annoying. But it also might be a good thing. (I know, I know. Hear me out!)

item.title: Danny Boyle confirms Jack O'Connell's cult leader in '28 Years Later: The Bone Temple' was inspired by British TV presenter Jimmy Savile
item.description: After Jimmy Savile's death, hundreds accused him of abuse. Danny Boyle says the Jimmy Crystal character reflects what society chooses to remember.

item.title: Gavin Newsom is heading to Davos with plans to call out Trump
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom is going to Davos next week with plans to call out Trump and "complicit" CEOs.

item.title: Figma CEO Dylan Field says he has a 'bias' for hiring young workers because they're likely AI natives
item.description: Figma CEO Dylan Field says AI skills give young professionals an edge in hiring as the job market faces AI-driven changes.

item.title: California sends xAI cease-and-desist letter, demanding it prevent sexualized deepfake images of minors
item.description: California's Attorney General sent a cease-and-desist letter to xAI to prevent Grok from continuing to create sexualized deepfake images of children.

item.title: Oprah has endured as a weight-loss icon. Not even GLP-1s can change that.
item.description: Media mogul Oprah Winfrey is poised to change how we talk about the GLP-1 trend. It's part of the 'Oprah Effect' on wellness.

item.title: An OpenAI researcher turned venture capitalist says investors are 3 to 5 years behind the latest AI studies
item.description: Jenny Xiao, who founded Leonis Capital in 2021, said AI needs more investors who understand frontier AI technology.

item.title: OpenAI is turning to the court of public opinion in its battle with Elon Musk
item.description: OpenAI published a blog post on Friday that said Elon Musk never treated the AI startup as an independent nonprofit.
